text:
rui: Quick sync: CS reported customers seeing "charged to pool proj" while console shows the original SA. We need a short-term telemetry fix + rollout plan.

anya: Seen it. Root cause: router falls back to pooled project but console pulls pre-routing header (X-Consumer-SA) for the UI label.

matt: Two parts: (1) emit a low-cardinality metric for routing decisions, (2) emit sampled detailed events with a routing_hash for drilldowns. Keep cardinality low.

claudia: UX ask from product: add a tiny label "Billed: <project>" next to usage; also show "Acting SA" separately. Tooltip explains pooled billing and a link to request pinned capacity. Flag behind `ui.auth.routing.v1`.

anya: Proposed metrics: increment `auth.routing.count{reason,is_fallback}`. For detailed records emit `auth.routing.decision` only when sampled. Include fields in event as plain short strings: requested_id, effective_project, reason, routing_hash, ts.

matt: Sampling strategy: default 0.5% global, 100% for SRE/CS orgs or when customer files a ticket. For private installs default to aggregated-only; customers can opt into detailed via `telemetry.routing_mode=full`.

rui: Security check: ensure we never put tenant/project ids in public logs for private control plane. Private -> local sink only. Public SaaS -> sampled events to our secure telemetry store with 30d retention.

cs-bot: CS ticket #CS-3489 linked (org: exampleco). Set sampling=100% for this org until triage complete.

matt: Implementation checklist: router adds routing_hash+effective_project to request context; metrics emitted synchronously; sampled event posted to telemetry async. routing_hash deterministic for short time window so console drilldown can find the event.

anya: Alerting idea: soft alert when fallback_rate(org,30m) > 0.5% -> notify CS triage channel; escalate to pager if >1% for 1h. Use metrics only so sampling doesn't affect counts.

claudia: Console behavior: label display order: Billed project (first), Acting SA (second). Clicking billed project opens filtered logs by routing_hash and time range. For privacy, URL does not reveal project id; drill uses routing_hash only.

rui: Rollout plan: behind flag `routing.telemetry.v1`. Stage: 5% internal orgs -> SRE+CS 100% -> ramp to 25% customer orgs next week -> full. Add a migration note for Dedicated / Private deployments (aggregated by default).

matt: Will open PRs: (1) router header + metric emission, (2) telemetry pipeline sampled sink + retention, (3) console card + drilldown UI. Tagging @anya @claudia for review.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled to canary-5. CI green.

anya: I'll add the telemetry schema doc to the PR and a short runbook for CS explaining the tile and what to tell customers.

claudia: I'll upload the mock to figma and include tooltip language: "Billed project: The project used for billing when requests are routed to pooled capacity. Click to see decision log."

rui: Thanks. Please paste PR links here when ready and I'll coordinate with support for the ramp. :thumbsup:
